entries.notes: One Pay Your Bill page covers everything: pay online or in MyApp, view past invoices, AutoPAY, payment plans and email invoices. AutoPAY is REQUIRED for patients renting equipment or on recurring supply orders who owe a deductible or coinsurance; Medicaid patients are exempt. The invoice goes out 10 days before each AutoPAY charge, and you cannot pick the debit day. Payment plans let you choose a date (call 855-389-4043). AutoPAY is required for rentals and recurring supplies that carry deductibles or coinsurance. The card is charged 10 days after the invoice opens, and you cannot choose the date. To cancel AutoPAY or set up a payment plan, call 855-389-4043. Electronic invoicing started 6/1/2025. Mailed checks go to a lockbox and can take 2-3 weeks to post. Solara Medical Supplies (diabetes/CGM) is an AdaptHealth company with its own portal. CMS DMEPOS 2024 supplier 'Adapthealth West, Llc' (Silt, CO; 11,830 Medicare beneficiaries) belongs to this brand. entries.notes: The Billing & Insurance page covers paying online, by phone or by mail, payment plans, and how posted payments show in 24-48 hours. It also covers secondary insurance and disputing a bill with your EOB (fax 866-227-2939). The Medicare & Medicaid billing page is https://www.labcorp.com/patients/billing/medicare-medicaid. A payment plan (an installment schedule) is the recurring-payment option; no separate autopay doc. Billing page: pay in the Labcorp Patient portal (https://patient.labcorp.com/invoices/find) or as a guest (https://www.labcorp.com/patients/bill-pay); accepts major cards, HSA cards, PayPal, Google Pay and Apple Pay; payment plans and invoice history are in the portal or MyLabcorp app, or by phone at 800-845-6167. LabAccess Partnership Program for uninsured patients; Good Faith Estimates: https://www.labcorp.com/patients/billing/good-faith-estimate. No autopay-cancel page is published; manage the plan in the portal or call. Payment plans can be set up in the MyLabcorp app, the Labcorp Patient portal, at a patient service center or by phone (800-845-6167); phone payments are accepted anytime; bills carry a QR code for payment. Labcorp states it is NOT affiliated with Doxo or other invoice-payment services, so seniors should pay only through labcorp.com, the app, phone or mail. No recurring autopay is documented. Enzo Clinical Labs (NY/NJ) was acquired by Labcorp in 2023: enzoclinicallabs.com now redirects to labcorp.com, so former Enzo patients pay through Labcorp. Invitae (genetic testing) is also part of Labcorp. Labcorp bill-pay page: pay by MyLabcorp app, Labcorp Patient portal, phone 800-845-6167 (M-F 8-5 ET), mail or kiosk; accepts major cards, HSA cards, PayPal, Google Pay, Apple Pay. Payment plans can be created in the app or portal. Labcorp says it deletes card information after processing each payment (no stored-card autopay). The portal shows bills and a summary of previous payments and insurance adjustments for open invoices. LabAccess Partnership program offers discounted rates for uninsured/underinsured patients. The billing page documents payment plans  but no recurring autopay, and Labcorp says it deletes card data after each payment.

NSM FAQ: stair lifts can be rented month to month or on a Rent to Purchase Plan (up to 3 months' rent credited toward purchase); call NSM about rental billing. The Make a Payment page offers card/check payment only and describes no assistance, financing or payment plan.

entries.name: Quest Diagnostics
entries.service_area_detail: National clinical lab; ~2,000+ patient service centers; bills patients directly for lab testing ordered by doctors. Acquired Fresenius' Spectra Laboratories assets (2025), so dialysis lab bills may come from Quest.
entries.phone_customer_service: 866-MYQUEST (866-697-8378); also the customer-service number printed on your bill

entries.senior_programs: Financial Assistance Program: up to 100% discount at or below the federal poverty level, discounts up to 200% FPL, supplemental help up to 600% FPL. Monthly payment plans available.
entries.notes: Billing FAQs explain why you got a bill and the card-on-file policy (the card is charged only after insurance adjudicates, 1-6 weeks). Bill number examples: https://patientbill.questdiagnostics.com/bill-examples. Online contact: https://patientbill.questdiagnostics.com/contact-service. No autopay for patient lab bills; payment plans are the recurring option. MyQuest app is for results and appointments. Billing FAQ  covers several tasks on one page: email bill notices and paperless are set in MyQuest > Account Settings > Communications Preferences; past bills and transactions are in MyQuest; a one-time passcode on the billing site finds a bill if no paper statement arrived. Mail payments go to the 'Send Payments To' address on the bill. The FAQ warns that third-party payers such as Doxo may add fees. No recurring autopay documented; monthly payment plans exist. Spectra Laboratories (Fresenius's renal lab): Quest agreed to buy select Spectra assets in 2025, and spectra-labs.com now redirects to the Fresenius divestment announcement, so dialysis-related lab billing is moving to Quest. Quest does not keep a card on file for autopay. Its billing FAQ explains that at a visit you may authorize a card for an estimated amount, an e-receipt is emailed only if the card is charged, and 'each appointment is independent' (the card is not charged automatically for future visits). Each service gets its own bill number; payment receipts are emailed to the address given when paying.

entries.name: Tandem Diabetes Care
entries.service_area_detail: Insulin pump maker (t:slim X2, Mobi); ships pumps/supplies direct and bills insurance in many cases.
entries.notes: Insulin pumps (t:slim X2, Mobi) and supplies bought direct. Payments and receipts are handled in the Tandem Source platform; the support article  explains printing a payment receipt from Completed Activities or Orders > View Receipt. A related article covers updating the default payment method: https://www.tandemdiabetes.com/support-center/software-and-apps/tandem-source/article/update-default-payment-method-in-tandem-source. The Flexible Payment Plan ($0 down, up to 48 months, $6.50/month fee, credit card) is NOT available to Medicare, Medicaid or TRICARE members or Florida residents. Pumps through distributors (Byram, Edgepark etc.) are billed by that distributor.
